proposals.evidence: DEDR2552 gives Tamil/Malayalam iravu, irā, rā night, Irula rāvu night, Malayalam iruṭṭu/iriṭṭu darkness, and Kannada iruḷ/iraḷu/iraṭu/irḷu night. The selected simple southern forms match the night/darkness family, including loss of initial i- and final-vowel variants. Darkness-form responses elicited as night retain that survey sense; compound rāpodu-type answers are handled separately. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3582 gives Tamil naṭa, Malayalam naṭakka, Kannada naḍe/naḍi, Kodagu naḍa- and Tulu naḍapuni to walk. These complete southern survey naḍa/naḍi/naḍakk-/naḍap- forms preserve the stem and source inflection; the Kudiya naḍapu comparison follows intransitive Tulu naḍapuni, not Kannada causative naḍapu. Longer or opaque responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4004 gives Tamil/Malayalam paḻam ripe fruit, Irula pammu/pāmu, Toda pum, Kannada paṇṇu, Parji pal, Gondi paṇḍ(i) and Konda paṇḍu. Selected survey paḷam/payam/pagam/paśam/pām- responses preserve lect-specific reflexes or loss of the medial retroflex, and Kannada/related annu reflects loss of initial h-. These are comparative family proposals; the separate Indo-Aryan-looking phal forms and opaque responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
